Talk at the TUD Geodetic Colloquium

On Wednesday, 25 May 2011, Prof. Jürgen Döllner gives an invited talk on "Service-based Visualization of complex geovirtual 3D Models" at the Geodetic Colloquium at the Technical University Dresden.
